    c = (min(p[1] for p in b) + max(p[1] for p in b)) // 2

for n in G_objects:
    b = n['boundary']
    r = (min(p[0] for p in b) + max(p[0] for p in b)) // 2
    c = (min(p[1] for p in b) + max(p[1] for p in b)) // 2
    print(f"  G at ({r},{c})")

    r = (min(p[0] for p in b) + max(p[0] for p in b)) // 2

    print(f"  N at ({r},{c})")
print(f"Gameplay changed: {last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")
